limitations: The two consumers are separate SDK instances run by this project, not independent people or organisations.
Signed envelopes are verified locally. Chain metadata, transaction links and query completeness rely on the configured RPC provider; no state proof is checked.
Historical receipts are operator observations, not cryptographic attestations of client execution. Every current request rereads graph and review evidence.
The release guard is deterministic and interpreted. No model inference runs. Qarinah evidence remains untrusted data.
